description: A start/stop plank hold timer with a 4-week progressive target chart built from your baseline.

faqs.a: Hold a straight line from head to heels, brace your core, and breathe normally. Stop if your lower back sags or hurts.
It counts your hold live and shows your best hold from this browser, plus weekly targets that grow from your baseline.
Add 10–15 seconds to your baseline and follow the same 4-week structure with 3 holds per day.
faqs.q: What if the targets feel too easy?

howto: Enter your current best plank hold in seconds.
Press Start timer, hold your plank, press Stop at failure.
Your best hold is saved in this browser.
Follow the 4-week target chart below the timer.
title: Plank Progression Timer
